Job Responsibilities: Install and/or Upgrade a wide variety of electrical components ranging from generators, rewires, additions, services, panels, etc.. in an efficient and productive manner Provide electrical service and/or repair to customers’ homes, apartments, and businesses as needed including presenting options and collecting for jobs completed Communicate with Dispatch, Supervisors, and Customers throughout projects about time frames, change orders, etc.  Must provide a safe and clean work environment to protect property of others and fellow coworkers Coordinate with utility service providers (NES, MTEMC, CEMC, etc.) and local code officials to ensure proper guidelines are established. Transport materials and tools to the job site and provide proper accounting of assigned tools. Responsible for adhering to all OSHA safety standards and regulations including the use of proper PPE at all times Keep truck clean, stocked and accurately inventoried. Perform other duties as assigned   Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: Must be highly detail-oriented due to the nature of the electrical field in ensure safety for fellow technicians, self, and property. Must be team oriented Ability to communicate effectively with customers and fellow coworkers Must be able to use a computer tablet, smart phone and read a map or follow GPS.   Responsibilities: A High School diploma or general education degree (GED) required. A valid driver's license and approved to drive by Company's insurance carrier. Willing to work hours outside of normal work schedule and on call schedule We sincerely thank all applicants in advance for submitting their interest in this position.
Hiller is an EEOC employer.Applicants will be required to undergo pre-employment drug screens and background checks. Apply today if you have what it takes to be a part of the industry's best team in the home service industry!
